A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CART and contain complete, readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that changes are confined to Table 2 and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original CART retrieval results across six datasets, efficiency experiments, component ablations, and configuration analyses, including appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains the original CART retrieval, efficiency, ablation, and configuration results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical identifier construction, caption enhancement, feature fusion, training losses, and constrained beam-search procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate text-to-image retrieval on Flickr30k and MS-COCO, text-to-audio retrieval on Clotho and AudioCaps, and text-to-video retrieval on MSR-VTT and MSVD. The simulated efficiency scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–3 is unchanged. Table 2 reorders LanguageBind(Audio) and adds source markers, but every baseline remains represented.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, training settings, metric definitions, and efficiency-testing procedures are unchanged. Table 2 omits selected MRR entries without documenting any change to the evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Component ablations, encoder/decoder depth studies, identifier and codebook sensitivity analyses, and semantic-embedding visualizations remain identical, including Appendices E–H.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed specifications, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 2 changes LanguageBind(Audio)'s Clotho MRR@10 from 32.9 to 26.6. It replaces the Clotho and AudioCaps MRR@10 values for CLAP-HTSAT, HTSAT-BERT, VALOR-B, and ONE-PEACE(Pretrained) with dashes, removing eight entries. All recall values, CART scores, and other results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in Section 3, including quantization, fusion, and training objectives, are unchanged. Appendix D's metric definitions are also identical; no proofs or theoretical results are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about modality coverage, coarse-to-fine semantic modeling, retrieval performance, and efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of performance and ablations are unchanged. Both versions retain the same limitations concerning dynamically changing corpora and support for natural-language queries only.

D1.justification: Table 2 newly identifies literature-sourced baseline results with asterisks, clarifying the earlier blanket attribution to original papers or official reproduction. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and novelty positioning are unchanged. Table 2's source markers clarify result provenance without adding references or revising research positioning.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp and Table 2's brief source annotation change. The remaining prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 adds source asterisks and their caption key, moves LanguageBind(Audio) below ONE-PEACE, and has slight local spacing changes. No figures or tables are added or removed, and the appendix layout is identical.

improvement.justification: Table 2 improves provenance and internal consistency: LanguageBind(Audio)'s revised Clotho MRR@10 of 26.6 no longer exceeds the approximately 30.6 upper bound implied by its unchanged recall values, unlike v2's 32.9. Eight omitted MRR entries reduce comparison completeness, and the revisions lack explanation. The demonstrated gain is therefore limited to reporting quality; the method and CART results are unchanged.
